mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(monthly_fee_no, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM monthly_fee WHERE monthly_fee_no LIKE 'monthly_fee_%';
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_fee ( monthly_fee_no, ent_ceo_no, ent_emp_id, manager_id, payment_details, platform_fee, ent_fee, pay_status, provision_date, settlement_month ) VALUES ( #{monthlyFeeNo}, #{entCeoNo}, #{entEmpId}, #{managerId}, #{paymentDetails}, #{platformFee}, #{entFee}, #{payStatus}, #{provisionDate}, #{settlementMonth} )

INSERT INTO settlement ( settlement_month, ent_ceo_no, ent_emp_id, platform_emp_id, total_ent_fee_rental, total_platform_fee_rental, total_ent_fee, total_platform_fee, total_ent_penalty, total_platform_penalty, total_approved_amount, total_net_platform_fee, settlement_date, settlement_status ) VALUES ( #{settlementMonth}, #{entCeoNo}, #{entEmpId}, #{platformEmpId}, #{totalEntFeeRental}, #{totalPlatFormFeeRental}, #{totalEntFee}, #{totalPlatFormFee}, #{totalEntPenalty}, #{totalPlatFormPenalty}, #{totalApprovedAmount}, #{totalNetPlatformFee}, NOW(), '정산완료' )
